zh.name: 「无缘黎明」卡厄斯兰那
zh.desc: 伴随黑潮而来、狩猎泰坦火种的无名剑士，面具下石像般的面容与救世主无异，几近崩毁，仿佛将死的薪柴。\n空洞的回响自火焰中来：一切皆为徒劳。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对指定我方单体及其相邻目标造成物理属性伤害。
对我方全体目标造成物理属性伤害，被击中目标降低生命值的一部分转化为<u>【侵蚀】</u>。

240320101.name: 侵蚀
240320101.desc: 攻击后回复侵蚀部分的生命值，击中的目标数量越多，回复的生命值越高。受到伤害时，降低生命值的一部分转化为侵蚀。消耗生命值时，降低的生命值会全部转化为侵蚀。通过回复生命值的方式解除侵蚀时，使自身获得【焕新】效果。【焕新】：下次攻击造成的伤害提高。

skill_list.skill_desc: 使【残破容器】进入【共祭】状态，在数次行动内施放【幽冥的悼念】。
与【残破容器】一同施放【亡死的黑云】或【将尽的命数】，随后吸收【残破容器】治疗自身，并获得<u>【灾难之力】</u>。

403401001.name: 灾难之力
403401001.desc: 施放特定技能时，消耗【灾难之力】的所有层数追加攻击段数。

skill_list.skill_desc: 获得<u>【灾难之力】</u>并进入【沉默的悲叹】状态，下次行动时施放【莫因舍弃而哭泣】。

403401001.name: 灾难之力
403401001.desc: 施放特定技能时，消耗【灾难之力】的所有层数追加攻击段数。

skill_list.skill_desc: 消耗所有<u>【灾难之力】</u>对我方全体造成数次少量物理属性伤害，消耗的【灾难之力】层数越多，伤害的段数越多，随后对我方全体造成少量物理属性伤害。

403401001.name: 灾难之力
403401001.desc: 施放特定技能时，消耗【灾难之力】的所有层数追加攻击段数。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对我方全体造成物理属性伤害，消耗所有<u>【灾难之力】</u>额外造成数次少量物理属性伤害，消耗的【灾难之力】层数越多，伤害的段数越多。

403401001.name: 灾难之力
403401001.desc: 施放特定技能时，消耗【灾难之力】的所有层数追加攻击段数。

skill_list.skill_desc: 施放【亡死的黑云】或【将尽的命数】时，消耗生命值召唤【残破容器】，并使消耗的生命值转化为<u>【苦痛缠绕】</u>。若该攻击召唤的【残破容器】被消灭，则额外对自身造成物理属性伤害。当自身再次施放【亡死的黑云】或【将尽的命数】时，曾被该攻击召唤的【残破容器】将一同发起攻击，随后被自身吸收， 回复转化为<u>【苦痛缠绕】</u>的生命值并使自身获得<u>【灾难之力】</u>。

403401001.name: 灾难之力
403401001.desc: 施放特定技能时，消耗【灾难之力】的所有层数追加攻击段数。

403401002.name: 苦痛缠绕
403401002.desc: 吸收【残破容器】后回复召唤该【残破容器】时消耗的生命值，【残破容器】被消灭后，无法再回复召唤该【残破容器】时消耗的生命值。

skill_list.skill_desc: 施放【沉默的悲叹】时，消耗生命值召唤【残破容器】，并使消耗的生命值转化为<u>【苦痛缠绕】</u>。当拥有的<u>【灾难之力】</u>层数不为0时，若【残破容器】受到致命攻击，则立即消耗1层<u>【灾难之力】</u>和一定比例的生命值，重新召唤【残破容器】。施放【莫因舍弃而哭泣】时，吸收【残破容器】并回复转化为<u>【苦痛缠绕】</u>的生命值。

403401001.name: 灾难之力
403401001.desc: 施放特定技能时，消耗【灾难之力】的所有层数追加攻击段数。

403401002.name: 苦痛缠绕
403401002.desc: 吸收【残破容器】后回复召唤该【残破容器】时消耗的生命值，【残破容器】被消灭后，无法再回复召唤该【残破容器】时消耗的生命值。

skill_list.skill_desc: 获得一定层数的【减伤】，使自身受到的伤害降低，每有1个【残破容器】被消灭后失去1层。

en.name: Dawn-Denied Khaslana
en.desc: A nameless swordsman, borne by the black tide to hunt Coreflames, wears a mask carved with the stoic visage of a deliverer... Yet his form crumbles like dying kindling.\n From the flames echoes hollowness: All is futility.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals Physical DMG to one designated target and adjacent targets.
Deals Physical DMG to all targets. Converts a portion of the hit target's reduced HP to "<u>Corrosion</u>."

240320101.name: Corrosion
240320101.desc: After attacking, restore a portion of Corroded HP. The more targets are hit, the more HP is restored. When taking DMG, a portion of the HP reduced is converted to Corrosion. When HP is consumed, the reduced HP will all be converted to Corrosion. When Corrosion is dispelled via restorative means, this unit obtains "Renewal." "Renewal" increases the DMG dealt by the next attack.

skill_list.skill_desc: Causes "Long-Shattered Vessel" to enter the "Mutual Sacrifice" state. Uses "Underworld's Grief" in a certain number of turns.
Uses "Demise's Storm" or "Fading Fate" together with "Long-Shattered Vessel." Then, absorbs "Long-Shattered Vessel" to heal this unit while obtaining <u>"Calamity Power."</u>

403401001.name: Calamity Power
403401001.desc: When using certain abilities, consume all "Calamity Power" stacks to increase Hits Per Action.

skill_list.skill_desc: Obtains <u>"Calamity Power"</u> and enters the "Silent Sorrow" state. Uses "Cry Not for the Discarded" in the next action.

403401001.name: Calamity Power
403401001.desc: When using certain abilities, consume all "Calamity Power" stacks to increase Hits Per Action.

skill_list.skill_desc: Consumes all <u>"Calamity Power"</u> and deals several instances of minor Physical DMG to all targets. The more "Calamity Power" stacks are consumed, the more instances of DMG. Then, deals minor Physical DMG to all targets.

403401001.name: Calamity Power
403401001.desc: When using certain abilities, consume all "Calamity Power" stacks to increase Hits Per Action.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals Physical DMG to all targets and consumes all <u>"Calamity Power"</u> to additionally deal several instances of minor Physical DMG. The more "Calamity Power" stacks are consumed, the more instances of DMG.

403401001.name: Calamity Power
403401001.desc: When using certain abilities, consume all "Calamity Power" stacks to increase Hits Per Action.

skill_list.skill_desc: When using "Demise's Storm" or "Fading Fate," consumes HP to summon "Long-Shattered Vessel" and convert the consumed HP into <u>"Entangled By Agony."</u> If the "Long-Shattered Vessel" summoned by this attack is defeated, additionally deals Physical DMG to this unit. When this unit uses "Demise's Storm" or "Fading Fate" again, the "Long-Shattered Vessel" that was summoned by the attacking ability will attack together with this unit. This unit will then absorb the Vessel, restoring the HP that was converted to <u>"Entangled By Agony"</u> and granting <u>"Calamity Power"</u> to this unit.

403401001.name: Calamity Power
403401001.desc: When using certain abilities, consume all "Calamity Power" stacks to increase Hits Per Action.

403401002.name: Entangled By Agony
403401002.desc: After absorbing "Long-Shattered Vessel," restores the HP consumed to summon the current "Long-Shattered Vessel." After "Long-Shattered Vessel" is defeated, this unit cannot restore the HP consumed used to summon the current "Long-Shattered Vessel" again.

skill_list.skill_desc: When using "Silent Sorrow," consumes HP to summon a "Long-Shattered Vessel" and converts the consumed HP into <u>"Entangled By Agony."</u> When stacks of <u>"Calamity Power"</u> are not at 0 and if a "Long-Shattered Vessel" receives a killing blow, immediately consumes 1 stack of <u>"Calamity Power"</u> and a percentage of HP to resummon a "Long-Shattered Vessel." When using "Cry Not for the Discarded," absorbs any "Long-Shattered Vessel" and restores the HP that was converted to <u>"Entangled By Agony."</u>

403401001.name: Calamity Power
403401001.desc: When using certain abilities, consume all "Calamity Power" stacks to increase Hits Per Action.

403401002.name: Entangled By Agony
403401002.desc: After absorbing "Long-Shattered Vessel," restores the HP consumed to summon the current "Long-Shattered Vessel." After "Long-Shattered Vessel" is defeated, this unit cannot restore the HP consumed used to summon the current "Long-Shattered Vessel" again.

skill_list.skill_desc: Receives a certain number of stacks of "DMG reduction," reducing DMG received by this unit. 1 stack is lost after defeating 1 "Long-Shattered Vessel."
